newsitem.title: RUSSIA: IFC lends $10 mln to Russia's Troika Dialog.
newsitem.headline: IFC lends $10 mln to Russia's Troika Dialog.

text.p: The International Finance Corporation (IFC), the private-sector arm of the World Bank, plans to lend $10 million to Troika Dialog investment bank, Troika said on Tuesday.
The investment includes a long-term credit line and a long-term credit convertible into Troika Dialog shares, it said in a statement.
Troika Dialog officials refused to say how many shares could be converted under the scheme.
The signing ceremony will take place on October 2 in Washington.

Troika Dialog, the investment banking arm of Dialog Bank, is one of the leading companies on the Russian securities market, dealing in equities and government securities, and providing corporate finance and asset management services.
